title: toxicodendron bolusii
intro: Toxicodendron bolusii, commonly known as Stinkwood, is a plant species native to South Africa, belonging to the Anacardiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Stinkwood include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipruritic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Stinkwood include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
